confirmedCause: The case runs the unfixed owner, which records a schemaVersion 1 intent. The current status() refuses that legacy custody and reports state 'unknown' (legacy_private_key_custody_unavailable) from its first observation, independent of the original worker's lifetime, so terminal() read worker.stderr.private at its first non-empty observation while that worker was still writing its uncaught-exception traceback. CPython 3.12 prints tracebacks in C, one line-buffered write per line, and opens and re-reads each frame's source file after writing its '  File' line, so a reader can see a File line without its source line; the CI read ended right after the importlib import_module frame line. The complete stderr of the same unfixed worker, reproduced with CPython 3.12.13 and 3.14.3, continues through the frozen importlib frames and source_module_loader.py line 207 to 'ValueError: expected_source_bytes_changed', the intended refusal of the undeclared lazy ssh_automatic_program import. Import machinery, source loader hooks, package __spec__, bytecode caching (the worker runs with -I -B and compiles held bytes) and sys.modules state do not differ: the worker fails on the same statement on both versions. The same case passed on the same CPython 3.12.15 in Fast Checks run 40187427911 for cc2873b5.
versionDifference: CPython 3.13 and later print uncaught exceptions through the traceback module, which looks up every source line before writing and then writes whole frames, so a concurrent reader sees the header line or whole frames only; CPython 3.12 and earlier write each File line, source line and caret line separately, reading that frame's source file in between. The race exists on every supported version, with more and finer write boundaries up to 3.12: measured locally on macOS, the unfixed worker's stderr grew in 34 observed steps over 0.78 ms on 3.12.13 and in 12 over 0.64 ms on 3.14.3 (its 35-byte header first, whole frames 0.47 ms later).
controlledRegression: agent_tools.tests.test_ssh_program_lazy_dependency_stderr_completion runs the actual test_direct_source_session_lazy_dependency_before_red_current_green case from this whole beforeimage and from the current module, with the real unfixed owner and its real worker, and the fixed owner's real worker. Only when the original worker's own stderr bytes reach worker.stderr.private is controlled: its saved-worker launch runs unchanged with stderr through a pipe, and a fixed stdlib relay, which the unfixed owner records in owner.json and reaps as its worker, writes those actual bytes into that file through the importlib import_module frame line, where the CI read ended, and the rest after the case's second observation of the partial file; it exits only after every byte is in the file. Unfixed, once with NO_COLOR=1 and once with FORCE_COLOR=1 set explicitly: the statement at line 344 fails with the trace's message shape, quoting exactly the partial bytes read at its first non-empty observation, without the final ValueError line. Fixed, with each: terminal() keeps observing past the partial file, reports the whole stderr once that exact recorded worker exited, the assertion matches, and the fixed-owner half still runs the target once with exit code 0.
